text:
Predicates:
Space(x) ::: x is space.
Vampire(x) ::: x is a vampire.
Sucks(x) ::: x sucks.
Vacuum(x) ::: x is a vacuum.
Duster(x) ::: x is a household appliance that doesn't suck.
Premises:
Vacuums(x) → Sucks(x) ::: Vacuums suck.
Vampire(x) → Sucks(x) ::: Vampires suck.
Space(x) → Vacuum(x) ::: Space is a vacuum.
Duster(d) ∧ ¬Sucks(d) ::: A duster is a household appliance that doesn't suck.
Conclusion:
Space(x) ∧ Vampire(x) ::: Space is a vampire.
